entries.category_description: Supply of services by undertakers and cremation services, and the supply of goods related thereto
entries.comment: Includes only: burial and cremation; preparing the dead for burial or cremation and embalming, and the services of gravediggers; preparation of funeral and cremation rites; rental of equipped premises and mortuaries; transport of deceased, supply of goods directly related to funeral services, provided by the provider of these services.
